properties.content:

Incident Type: MOBILE

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: ACE HARDWARE
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.114279, -88.245546 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 11 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** ON DECEMBER 16 A TRACTOR TRAILER EASTBOUND ON I-74 OUTSIDE OF CHAMPAIGN IL WHEN WHITEOUT CONDITIONS SUDDENLY OCCURRED AND THE DRIVER VEERED OFF THE ROAD. TRACTOR TRAILER STOPPED BY LANDING INTO A STORM WATER DRAINAGE BASIN NEAR MILE MARKER 161. AT THE TIME OF THE ACCIDENT THERE WAS NO EVIDENCE OF FLUID LEAKAGE FROM THE TRACTOR. HOWEVER, ON DECEMBER 15, THE PROPER TOWING EQUIPMENT FINALLY ARRIVED AND EXCAVATED THE BOTTOM PORTION OF THE TRACTOR, THE TOWING COMPANY NOTICED SOME ENGINE OIL ON THE WATER. THEY EVENTUALLY MENTIONED THIS OBSERVATION TO AN ACE HARDWARE REPRESENTATIVE. THE EXACT AMOUNT OF MOTOR THAT MAY HAVE SPILLED CANNOT BE DETERMINED, BUT THE MAXIMUM WOULD HAVE BEEN 11 GALLONS BASED ON THE TRAILERS OIL PAN CAPACITY.
